name: atm-dashboard
description: Source for the Agentic Task Manager dashboard. Builds to a single self-contained HTML file.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prepare: git -C .. config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || echo "prepare: git hooks not enabled (not a usable git checkout, e.g. CI)"
scripts.test:e2e:linux-snapshots: docker run --rm -v "$(cd .. && pwd)":/repo -w /repo/dashboard mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble sh -c "npm ci && npm run build && npx playwright test visual --update-snapshots=missing"
